notes: Actions the windowed app adds to games/sepulcra/data/input.json (merged at start-up; names must not clash). Gamepad: left stick moves the cursor, South builds, North cycles the selection (until the radial menu exists), West upgrades, View sells, R3 removes a wall, L3 calls the next wave.

actions.name: upgrade
actions.description: Carve the next tier into the stone under the cursor.

actions.name: sell
actions.description: Sell the stone under the cursor (70% back).

actions.name: unwall
actions.description: Remove the wall under the cursor.

actions.name: call_wave
actions.description: Start the next wave now (bonus dust).

actions.name: speed
actions.description: Cycle the game speed (x1, x2, x4).

actions.name: new_game
actions.description: Start a new run after the end.

actions.name: pan
actions.description: Pan the camera this frame, in screen widths: +x = right, +y = into the screen.
